definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese form of comedic storytelling performed by a single seated performer using only a fan and a small cloth as props.

examples.japanese: {落語|らくご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}きに→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to listen to rakugo.

examples.japanese: {落語|らくご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦オチ→オチ：08939_ochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{面白|おもしろ}かった→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧。
examples.english: The punchline of the rakugo was funny.

examples.japanese: ⟦{落語|らくご}{家|か}→落語家：28498_rakugoka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{修行|しゅぎょう}→修行：05522_shugyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Becoming a rakugo performer requires long training.

notes:
COMPOUND: {落|らく} (fall, drop) + ⟦{語|ご}→〜語：09841_go⟧ (words, story) - referring to the "⟦{落|お}ち→落ち：08939_ochi⟧" (punchline/fall)

PERFORMANCE STYLE:
- Performed seated on a cushion (⟦{座布団|ざぶとん}→座布団：06120_zabuton⟧)
- Uses only two props: a fan (⟦{扇子|せんす}→扇子：04039_sensu⟧) and a small cloth (⟦{手拭|てぬぐい}→手拭い：06123_tenugui⟧)
- One performer plays all characters, using voice and posture changes

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {落語|らくご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ (to listen to rakugo)
- ⟦{落語|らくご}{家|か}→落語家：28498_rakugoka⟧ (rakugo performer)
- ⟦{寄席|よせ}→寄席：12389_yose⟧ (rakugo theater/variety hall)
- ⟦オチ→オチ：08939_ochi⟧/⟦{落|お}ち→落ち：08939_ochi⟧ (punchline)
- ⟦{古典|こてん}→古典：00242_koten⟧{落語|らくご} (classical rakugo)
- ⟦{新作|しんさく}→新作：09523_shinsaku⟧{落語|らくご} (new/modern rakugo)

FAMOUS VENUES:
- {鈴本|すずもと}{演芸場|えんげいじょう} (Suzumoto Engei Hall - Tokyo)
- {天満|てんま}{天神繁昌亭|てんじんはんじょうてい} (Osaka)
